studies.interpretation: Overall cTfh proportion did not differ, whereas Tfh1 subset frequency increased. This cannot be compared directly with another study until gates and denominators are matched.

comparisons.comparison: Ricard: total cTfh percentage and absolute counts increased; Ly: total cTfh proportion unchanged, Tfh1 subset increased.
comparisons.additionalFinding: Ricard also reports no significant Tfh1/2/17 subset percentage differences within cTfh in its cohort (Figure 1E). This makes subtype gating, clinical heterogeneity and sampling especially important.
